title: Oracle Essbase Dimension
description: A dimension in an Oracle Essbase database outline. Dimensions define the axes of a multi-dimensional data model and contain hierarchical members. Common dimension types include accounts, time, scenario, entity, and attribute dimensions.

name.description: Dimension name as defined in the database outline.

type.description: Dimension type classification. Accounts dimensions hold numeric measures. Time dimensions represent temporal periods. Attribute dimensions provide alternate categorizations.

storageType.description: How the dimension data is stored. Dense dimensions have data at most intersections. Sparse dimensions have data at few intersections.

tag.description: Dimension tag used for categorization and identification within the outline.

memberCount.description: Total number of members in the dimension hierarchy.
